title: Luis FB Possible NDE 9107
content: On 12/04/2020, I underwent surgery to repair an injury to the tendons of my rotator cuff. The surgery lasted almost 3 ½ hours. In the middle of the procedure, I had to be sedated again because I was waking up. During the post-surgery recovery phase, my wife, my mother, and my sister stayed in the room. During that time, I went somewhere else. I was with a person all in white, who’s face I couldn’t see. I was led me by the hand to a large plantation. Many people were working in a large vegetable garden. There was a large botanical garden on the other side of that. When I arrived at the vegetable garden, some people came over to speak with me. The first one I spoke with was my grandfather. Then, I spoke with my father-in-law. My grandma spoke of events and things that had happened to me when I was a child. I saw my cousin, Luis, who had drowned. Then I spoke with Marcos from church, who had been buried to death when he was 7 years old. I spoke with my sister’s mother-in-law. I also spoke with a person I knew who had passed away last month. Then I met Eliane’s great-grandmother. They touched the surgery site and told me that I would not feel any pain. Then, I heard my mother and the nurse calling me but the person that was with me told me that I was not going back to my body yet. Finally, everyone one the other side said goodbye to me one by one. At that point, I was sent to go open a door to leave this place. I opened the door and left. I was totally out and didn’t wake up until around 7:00 p.m. A little bit later, I started to remember what had happened during the time that I had been over there. I had been over there 1 hour and 20 minutes. My mother was very moved by what I told her. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 04/12/2020 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes. While under general anesthesia and recovering from surgery How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I heard people telling me to wake up. My mother and the nurse called my name, but the person holding my hand said, 'You’re not leaving yet.' I lost awareness of my body. How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. I was moving around a lot in bed. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The whole time Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Time was fine. Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Normal vision Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Normal hearing Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes. I was in a dark corridor with a bright light at the end of it. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I saw several family members and friends who all deceased. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I saw very intense, white light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. At the end of the tunnel, we got to a large plantation. There were many people working in a large vegetable garden. On the other side, there was a large botanical garden. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt peace, joy, nervousness, and anger Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others. I was at peace. I wasn’t scared or had any other unpleasant feelings. Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events. My grandmother reminded me of events from my childhood. Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Seek the truth more. What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Change my attitudes. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I saw a Being who was all in white and who had an intense light. I wasn’t able to see this Being’s face. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes. They conveyed to me that I would live 50 more years and that I was going back to my body to love myself more. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife does not exist Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes To take better care of myself. During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes To take better care of myself and to love myself more. Others would automatically also love me. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I'm more reflective. I am curious to know more about the secret of life. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? It helped me to reflect and change my attitudes. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes. After I left the hospital, at home I started to remember things and told my wife about everything that I had experienced. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain

arrival.other_being_detail: A person/Being "all in white" with "an intense light"; face not visible; held the experiencer's hand and said he was not going back to his body yet.

environment.environment_other_detail: Large plantation; many people working in a large vegetable garden; a large botanical garden on the other side.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: They conveyed he would live 50 more years and was going back to his body to love himself more / take better care of himself.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with bright light, arrival at plantation/gardens, encounters and conversations with deceased, then opening a door to leave and returning to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: They touched the surgery site and told him he would not feel pain; he was told he would live 50 more years; he was 'sent to go open a door to leave this place.' He also reported 'An afterlife does not exist.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You’re not leaving yet.” / “I was in a dark corridor with a bright light at the end of it.” / “I would live 50 more years and that I was going back to my body to love myself more.”
